title: ADA, ETH, XRP Climb as Bitcoin Breaks Above $93K, but Traders Warn of "Fakeout Rally
subTitle:
Major cryptocurrencies rose on Thursday, with Bitcoin briefly surging over $93,000 to lift market sentiment. But despite the uptick, traders remain cautious, flagging the move as a potential fakeout rally amid elevated volatility and macro uncertainty.
Market Snapshot: Gains Across Majors, But Questions Linger
Bitcoin hovered around $93,285 and extended its rebound, with analysts underlining that stability needs to be maintained within the $90,000–$91,000 support band.
One derivatives trader pointed out that the short-term structure has flipped into a choppy pullback and warned that failure to hold the support region could invite renewed downside.
Despite the caution, altcoins registered meaningful gains:
Cardano (ADA): +5%
Ethereum (ETH): +4%
XRP: modest gains with strengthening structure
Institutional flows remain in favor of Bitcoin, while ETF inflows reinforce BTC's dominance over ETH as risk appetite remains uneven across macro-driven markets.
Cardano (ADA): Governance Vote Lifts Sentiment
Cardano's ADA jumped 5% after a key milestone in on-chain governance was achieved.
One of the most important proposals, supported by 70 million ADA, got accepted, representing the first big governance vote for further acceleration of activity within the network.
The vote is expected to unlock funding and coordination for development pipelines, with investors viewing the event as early validation of Cardano's shift toward fully on-chain governance and community-led upgrades.
Ethereum (ETH): Fusaka Upgrade Strengthens L2 Settlement Path
Ethereum added 4% upon the launch of its highly-anticipated Fusaka upgrade.
The update will boost Ethereum's capability to process increasingly large transaction batches coming from its fast-growing Layer-2 ecosystem.
Fusaka brings improvements to:
Blob fee mechanics
Mainnet throughput
Validator efficiency
This upgrade arrives at the most critical moment as rollup activity continues to accelerate, supporting Ethereum's long-term vision as a global settlement layer for modular blockchains.
XRP: Quiet Strength as Base Builds
While XRP had smaller gains compared to ADA and ETH, the structure remains firm.
The token continues to build a base above $2.20, keeping the broader outlook constructive as buyers protect key intraday levels.
A sideways consolidation with stable momentum indicators could suggest potential continuation once broader market volatility subsides.
Bitcoin (BTC): Breakout or Fakeout?
Bitcoin's brief push above $93K caught attention, yet traders remain skeptical:
Volatility remains high.
The near-term trend looks set to continue unevenly.
Support of $90K–$91K remains critical for confirming direction At the institutional level, though, interest remains unabated: spot Bitcoin ETFs have continued to post inflows through the week, revealing sustained appetite even as macro anxieties-e.g., rate path uncertainty and shifting risk conditions-keep markets on edge. Conclusion While ADA, ETH, and XRP benefited from Bitcoin's upward pressure, the sustainability of the broader crypto rally remains uncertain. Investors will be closely monitoring whether or not BTC can stabilize above critical support zones and if altcoin strength will remain strong without dependency on Bitcoin's volatility. title: Massive Crypto Shakeout: $220M in Leveraged Positions Liquidated as Markets Rebound
subTitle:
The crypto market has once again shown its ruthless side. In the past 24 hours alone, more than $220 million in leveraged futures positions were wiped out as Bitcoin, Ethereum, and several altcoins made sudden, forceful price moves. The majority of the damage fell on traders who bet against the market, exposing the risks of high leverage and the unpredictability of short term crypto momentum.
What Triggered This Liquidation Wave?
Crypto futures trading allows users to amplify their positions with leverage, using borrowed funds to increase exposure. But when the market moves sharply, especially against highly leveraged positions, exchanges automatically close trades that no longer have enough collateral. This automated closure is called liquidation, and it often happens within seconds during volatile moves.
These liquidation clusters can accelerate price swings, creating feedback loops that push prices even further in the same direction.
A Breakdown of the $220M Liquidation Bloodbath
Here’s where traders felt the most pain:
Bitcoin (BTC)
$95M liquidated
Roughly 65% were short positions, meaning most traders expected a drop, but BTC surprised on the upside.
Ethereum (ETH)
$101M liquidated
Around 80% hit short sellers, reflecting an aggressive, sudden upward breakout that caught bears off guard.
Altcoins Snapshot
Solana (SOL): $14.2M , A reversal in sentiment led to long traders taking most of the hit.
XRP, AVAX & DOGE also saw multi million dollar liquidations but on a smaller scale compared to BTC and ETH.
The clear trend? Traders who bet against major market leaders like BTC and ETH suffered the hardest losses.
Why Shorts Were Hit So Hard
The past day delivered the perfect conditions for what traders call a short squeeze, a fast rise in price that forces short sellers to buy back their positions to avoid deeper losses. That buying pressure adds fuel to the rally, pushing prices even higher and triggering even more liquidations.
This cycle can intensify quickly, especially when traders use high leverage or when market sentiment flips rapidly.
Key Lessons for Crypto Traders
If this liquidation wave proves anything, it’s that managing risk is just as important, if not more important, than predicting market direction. Here are actionable takeaways:
1. Lower Your Leverage
The higher the leverage, the lower your margin for error. Even small moves can destroy a position.
2. Always Know Your Liquidation Price
Before entering a trade, calculate exactly where you could get liquidated. Avoid placing positions too close to that level.
3. Watch Funding Rates and Market Sentiment
Extreme funding or crowded positions often precede sharp reversals.
4. Use Stop-Loss Orders
Stops are essential in a fast moving, unpredictable environment. They minimize damage when markets turn.
The Market Impact of a Liquidation Event
Large liquidation clusters typically lead to increased volatility. They can accelerate moves, trigger larger swings, and shift short term sentiment dramatically. But there’s a silver lining: liquidation flushes help reset leverage across the market, often paving the way for more stable price action afterward.
Final Thoughts
The past 24 hours serve as a powerful reminder: the crypto market rewards discipline but punishes overconfidence. With more than $220 million erased from leveraged positions, this event highlights the importance of smart position sizing, emotional control, and respecting volatility.
In the world of crypto futures, being right isn’t enough, you also have to manage your risk with precision.
FAQs
Q: Why were so many short positions liquidated?
A sharp upward move in BTC and ETH forced short sellers into losses they couldn’t cover, triggering mass liquidations.
Q: Are liquidation waves harmful?
They can increase volatility, but they also clean out excessive leverage, creating healthier market conditions.
Q: How can I avoid getting liquidated?
Use low leverage, add extra collateral, set stop losses, and avoid overexposure.
Q: What is a long liquidation vs. short liquidation?
Long liquidation: Price drops; traders betting on a rise get liquidated.
Short liquidation: Price rises; traders betting on a drop get liquidated.
Q: Why was Solana different this time?
SOL saw more downward pressure, flipping the dynamic and hitting long traders instead of shorts.

Historical precedent: Pectra (smaller scope) pumped ETH 50% in a week; Fusaka's deeper changes could echo that if retail piles in. 
Bottom line: Fusaka makes ETH fundamentally stronger for mass adoption, which could catalyze a $5k run if the bull cycle holds—but it's not "after this upgrade" tomorrow. This is a huge step in merging traditional finance with on-chain assets for Parataxis Holdings. The New York–based digital asset investment firm has agreed to acquire a majority stake in South Korea's data-security company Sinsiway for 40 billion won ($27M) — with the plan to turn it into a publicly traded ether (ETH) treasury company.

Lastly, pending shareholder approval in January 2026, the company will be rebranded as Parataxis ETH, Inc. and become South Korea's first ETH-focused treasury platform backed by U.S. institutional capital. It will also add Parataxis' CEO, Edward Chin, to its board.

This move echoes an earlier initiative by the firm, Parataxis Korea, which focuses on bitcoin treasury operations and currently holds 150 BTC (~$14M). The ETH-focused entity will follow a similar playbook: it will accumulate ether as a core asset while bridging traditional institutions with on-chain opportunities spanning stablecoins, DeFi, and blockchain gaming.

Chin frames the acquisition as part of Ethereum's "super cycle," driven by accelerating Wall Street adoption and the network's maturity across real-use cases.

Parataxis Capital was founded in 2019 and continues to grow its operations managing hedge funds and instituting advisory services, with digital assets increasingly transitioning into public markets.

title: The Fusaka Upgrade: Scaling Ethereum's Data Layer
subTitle:
The Fusaka hard fork, Ethereum’s most recent major network upgrade following Pectra, marks a significant step toward achieving massive scalability. Named after the combination of the consensus layer upgrade (Fulu) and the execution layer upgrade (Osaka), Fusaka’s core mission is to dramatically increase the data capacity for Layer 2 rollups, leading to lower transaction costs for users.

The Scaling Breakthrough: PeerDAS (EIP-7594)

The centerpiece of the Fusaka upgrade is the introduction of Peer Data Availability Sampling (PeerDAS), defined by EIP-7594.

The Problem: The previous scaling upgrade, Dencun, introduced "blobs" for temporary data storage, but every full node still had to download and verify the entire blob data. This limited how much data could be added without burdening node operators.

The Solution: PeerDAS changes this paradigm. It uses erasure coding and cryptographic proofs to allow nodes to verify that data is available across the network by only downloading small, random samples (or "slices") of the data. This means node bandwidth and storage requirements remain low, while the network can safely handle a much higher volume of data.

This new sampling method unlocks the potential for Ethereum to handle up to 8 times the current data throughput capacity for rollups.

Direct Impact on Users and Layer 2s

The most noticeable change for everyday users is expected to be a substantial reduction in Layer 2 transaction fees (estimated between 40–60%). By making it exponentially cheaper for rollups (like Arbitrum, Optimism, and Base) to post their batched transaction data to Ethereum, the final cost passed on to the end user decreases significantly.

Other Key Upgrades

Fusaka is a comprehensive package of upgrades, including:

Increased Block Gas Limit: The block gas limit is increased, which allows the main Ethereum network (Layer 1) to process more complex transactions and generally increase throughput.

Blob Parameter Only (BPO) Forks: The upgrade introduces a mechanism (EIP-7892) that allows the network to safely and incrementally increase blob capacity in the future through simple, minor updates, avoiding the need for a full hard fork every time.

Security and UX Enhancements: Proposals like the secp256r1 precompile (EIP-7951) lay the foundation for simpler, more secure wallets using hardware-backed signatures (like Face ID or fingerprint readers).

By successfully deploying Fusaka, Ethereum validates its "rollup-centric" scaling vision, ensuring the network can handle mass adoption without sacrificing its core values of security and decentralization.

title: Курс биткоина сегодня: BTC стабилизируется near $93 000 после резкого отскока
subTitle:
В четверг курс Bitcoin #BTC  остаётся в пределах около $93 000 после стремительного скачка на предыдущей сессии. Стабилизация последовала за значительной распродажей в начале недели, когда цена падала близко к $84 000.

Что повлияло на восстановление

Главными факторами, поддержавшими рост цены, стали последние позитивные новости на regul‑фронте и изменения в институциональном поведении. Руководство регулятора США, SEC, объявило о намерении ввести специальные правила для компаний, работающих с цифровыми активами — «исключение для инноваций». Это решение укрепило уверенность рынка в благоприятной нормативной базе для криптовалют.
Кроме того, инвестиционная структура Vanguard смягчила прежние ограничения на крипто‑ETF, позволив своим клиентам торговать сторонними криптовалютными фондами через брокерскую платформу. Этот шаг привлёк внимание институциональных инвесторов и усилил приток капитала в биткоин.

Макроэкономический фон и ликвидность
Дополнительный стимул рынку дали ожидания снижения процентной ставки со стороны Federal Reserve (ФРС). Это повысило привлекательность рисковых активов, включая криптовалюты. После завершения программы количественного ужесточения ФРС возобновила крупномасштабные операции repo — свежие деньги вливаются в финансовую систему, что улучшает общие условия ликвидности.
Резкий подскок #BTC с отметки $84 000 до около $93 000 подчёркивает, насколько нестабильным сейчас остаётся рынок. Массовые закрытия коротких позиций (лиquidations) усиливают волатильность — что предоставляет как новые возможности, так и повышенные риски для инвесторов.

Альткоины на фоне роста рынка
На фоне позитивных движений по биткоину большинство альткоинов тоже продемонстрировали восходящую динамику, хоть и сдержанную:
Ethereum (#ETH ) вырос на 4,6%, достигнув около $3 210.
#XPR  снизился на 0,6% — до ~$2,18.
Solana #SOL прибавила 1%, Cardano — около 2%, а Polygon потерял ~0,9%.
Мем‑токены, такие как Dogecoin и $TRUMP, оставались практически без изменений.

Что важно учитывать инвесторам на Binance сейчас
С учётом текущего положения, инвесторам и трейдерам на Binance стоит учитывать следующие моменты:
Рынок остаётся волатильным — быстрые изменения могут дать шанс на прибыль, но и увеличить риск.
Регуляторные новости и действия крупных финансовых институтов продолжают влиять на курс — важно отслеживать релизы.
Альткоины демонстрируют разнонаправленную динамику, поэтому диверсификация портфеля может помочь снизить риски.
Благоприятный макроэкономический фон и ликвидность могут привлечь дополнительный капитал, что может стать драйвером роста криптовалют.

#ETH  In the summer of 2014, I had just turned 30, carrying 3000 yuan saved from working in a factory, and naively ventured into the world of digital currency.
At that time, Bitcoin was priced at 2000 yuan, and I almost bet my entire fortune on buying 1.5 of them.
Three months later, the price surged to 8000 yuan, but I didn't sell; a year later it skyrocketed to 60,000 yuan, with my account showing a nearly 90,000 yuan profit. I fantasized about a millionaire's life, but the "Mentougou Incident" caused the price to plummet.

In the end, I panicked and sold at 4000 yuan, only retrieving my initial 3000 yuan—I later realized that I had sold away what should have been my 6 million yuan.
Over the past decade, the market taught me lessons in the harshest way, and I summarized a few blood-and-tears lessons:
#tnsr  Investing spare cash is the survival baseline.
I once witnessed a neighbor mortgage their property to trade coins, and after a margin call, they lost their family. During my hardest times, my account balance was only 18 yuan, relying solely on a reserved 5000 yuan for living expenses to get through. Never use your survival capital to gamble for excess returns.

Cutting losses is more important than making profits:

In 2021, Dogecoin skyrocketed from 0.05 to 0.7 USD, and I missed the best selling opportunity due to greed, ultimately taking a loss. Now I set up automatic stop-loss orders; the market never lacks opportunities, but what it lacks is the capital to survive to the next opportunity.

Leverage is a deadly poison:

A friend used 20x leverage during the Luna crash and lost 800,000 yuan in 10 minutes. The essence of this game is that the house always wins; ordinary players have slim chances of success.
Cold wallets are the ultimate insurance.
When the FTX exchange went bankrupt, my 3000 USD is still on the liquidation list. Truly large assets must be kept away from third-party custody; although trading is inconvenient, it brings peace of mind for sleep.

News is often a harvesting trap:

By the time all "significant positive news" reaches retail investors, it has already become a harvesting scythe. Now, when I see the frenzy in groups, I directly mute it; real good opportunities have always been quiet.
There are no myths in this industry, only survivor bias. Those flaunting luxury cars and mansions are either scammers or temporarily lucky.

The real money-making veterans are quietly dollar-cost averaging, living ordinary lives. Although I missed out on 6 million, I spent ten years learning how to survive in the crypto world—in this 24/7 battlefield, I earned more than 600 U, and simply surviving is the biggest victory.

#ETH  The Beginning of the Sky Collapse: '3000 Becomes 1 Million? I Break Through to My Own Destiny in Three Steps'
—— It's not a tutorial, no shouting for tips, it's a story of a madman breaking through.

After being in the crypto world for a long time, you will discover a heart-wrenching truth:

With the same 3000 dollars, some lose everything in three days, while others change their fate in a year.

And I am the latter.

When I first entered the market, I couldn't even tell K-lines apart. I rushed in whenever I saw something popular and went all in whenever the market moved,

My account plummeted like a slide, and on the day it dropped to just 3000, I almost deleted the app and quit.

But that night, while repeatedly staring at my trading records, I suddenly realized:

It wasn't the market that was dragging me down; it was my own recklessness.

From that day on, I decided to do one thing only—change my fate.

Phase One: Accumulate the first bucket of 'courage capital'

I only took a small portion of my funds to test the waters, treating every operation as an exam.

When the market jumped, I didn't follow; when the noise was loud, I didn't look;

When the real opportunity came, I waited quietly like a hunter, waiting for that moment.

With that determination, I achieved my first 'small turnaround' in life.

At that time, the account amount wasn't large, but it was enough for me to see a fact:

It turns out fate can really be pushed open little by little by oneself.

Phase Two: Settle, learn, and hone 'hard skills'

A bunch of people around me continued to rush blindly:

I turned off all the noisy information and spread research materials all over the table:

Project background, industry trends, emotional cycles, technical rhythms… I chewed through the knowledge bit by bit.

During that time, I was like a madman,

Reviewing at three in the morning,

Then sitting in front of the computer in the morning watching the trends of mainstream coins.

Phase Three: From small money to 'big results'

The real breakthrough started after that.

I no longer fantasized about getting rich overnight, nor did I seek so-called 'chosen market trends.'

I only did three things:

I only entered when I understood, only acted when I could afford it, and waited when opportunities didn't come.

Just like that, the numbers in my account gradually went up.

From three thousand to ten thousand, from ten thousand to one hundred thousand,

And then from one hundred thousand to a million, something I never dared to believe.

Not by gambling, not by luck,

But by a normal person who was educated by the market countless times at midnight and gritted his teeth to start over,

A character and rhythm forged through hard work. Those who have been through the rain understand better how to hold an umbrella for you,

Are you ready for the journey of reversal in the crypto world?

#ETH 天崩开局《3000 变 100 万？我用三步闯出属于自己的命运》
——不是教学，不喊单，是一个疯子闯出来的故事。

在币圈混久了，你会发现一个扎心真相：

同样是 3000 块，有人三天输光，有人一年逆天改命。

而我，就是后者。

刚进圈时，连 K 线都分不清，看到热门就冲、行情一动就梭哈，

账户像坐滑梯一样往下掉，掉到只剩 3000 的那天，差点想删软件退圈。

可就在那晚，他反复盯着自己的交易记录，突然想明白：

不是行情在坑我，是我自己太莽。

从那天起，他决定只做一件事——改命。

第一阶段：积攒第一桶“胆量金”

我只拿出一小部分资金去试水，把每一次操作都当成考试。

行情跳，他不跟；人声嘈杂，他不看；

机会真正来临时，他像猎手一样安静，等那一下。

凭着那口狠劲，他完成了人生第一次“小翻身”。

那时候的账户金额不算大，却足以让他看到一个事实：

原来命运真能靠自己一点点推开。

第二阶段：沉淀、学习、打磨“硬实力”

周围一堆人继续瞎冲：

我关掉所有嘈杂信息，把研究资料摊满桌子：

项目背景、赛道趋势、情绪循环、技术节奏……一点点啃认知。

那段时间他像疯子一样，

凌晨三点在复盘，

早上又坐在电脑前盯主流币的走势。

第三阶段：从小钱到“大结果”

真正的突破，是从那之后开始的。

他不再幻想一夜暴富，也不再求所谓“天选行情”。

他做的只有三件事：

看得懂才上，承担得起才做，机会不来就等。

就这样，账户数字一点点往上跳。

从三千到一万，从一万到十万，

再从十万到他自己都不敢相信的——百万。

不是靠赌，不是靠运气，

而是靠一个在深夜被行情教育无数次、咬牙重来的普通人，

硬生生打磨出来的心性和节奏。淋过雨的人更懂怎么为你撑伞，

币圈逆袭之旅，你准备好了吗？

无脑吧？

Outdated USDC Permission Sparks $340K Wallet Drain Through Proxy Contract

⚠️ $340K Drained Due to Old USDC Approval — CertiK Issues Warning

CertiK has reported a new exploit involving a proxy contract (0x0689…4B43) that drained nearly $340,000 from user wallets. The root cause was surprisingly simple: a USDC token approval that users granted back in 2020 and never revoked.

This incident highlights the long-term risk of leaving old token approvals active. Once a smart contract is approved to spend your tokens, that permission remains live indefinitely—until you manually revoke it.

🔍 How the Exploit Occurred
The attacker took advantage of a proxy contract that still had outdated USDC spending permissions. Many affected wallets had approved this contract years ago, and those lingering permissions allowed the attacker to drain funds without any new interaction from the victims.

Because proxy contracts can upgrade their logic, they can be repurposed in malicious ways if compromised. If an attacker gains control of the contract’s logic, they can execute transactions using the old approvals still tied to user wallets.

🚨 Alert:
“An exploit on proxy contract 0x0689…4B43 drained roughly $340K due to a USDC approval from 2020. Users should review and revoke outdated permissions.”

🔐 Stay Safe: Revoke Unused Approvals
Users are strongly advised to revisit their wallet permissions and remove any old or unnecessary approvals. Tools like Revoke.cash and Etherscan Token Approval Checker make this easy.

Even if your wallet looks safe today, an old approval could expose it tomorrow. Regular permission cleanup is just as important as keeping your private keys secure

Use whale activity as context, not a direct buy/sell signal.

title: Хардфорк Fusaka успешно активирован в сети Ethereum: новое масштабирование, PeerDAS и ожидания рынка
subTitle:
Команда разработчиков Ethereum#ETH объявила об успешной активации обновления Fusaka в основной сети блокчейна. Хардфорк стал одним из наиболее значимых технологических этапов для Ethereum за последние годы и направлен на улучшение масштабируемости, доступности данных и эффективности работы валидаторов.
Обновление включило в себя десять предложений EIP и стало вторым по масштабу после хардфорка Pectra. Внедрение Fusaka знаменует начало нового этапа развития экосистемы Ethereum в рамках глобальной дорожной карты The Surge.

Ключевые изменения Fusaka: фокус на производительности и доступности данных
Основным элементом обновления стал EIP-7594, вводящий технологию PeerDAS (Peer Data Availability Sampling). Данный протокол позволяет валидаторам проверять не весь объём BLOB-данных, а лишь их небольшие сегменты. Такой подход значительно снижает нагрузку на узлы и повышает общую доступность данных для экосистемы.
По оценкам специалистов, PeerDAS станет фундаментальным звеном на пути к полноценному шардингу — давно ожидаемому механизму, который может радикально увеличить масштабируемость сети.
Кроме того, хардфорк включает несколько важных изменений, направленных на оптимизацию базового уровня сети:
• увеличение лимита газа на L1 более чем в два раза, что потенциально расширяет пропускную способность до 12 000 TPS;

• EIP-7825 — ограничение в 30 млн газа на транзакцию для защиты от перегрузок;

• EIP-7939 и EIP-7951 — улучшения производительности ZK-технологий и повышение эффективности zk-EVM и роллапов второго уровня.
Внедрение обновлений будет происходить поэтапно на протяжении декабря и января.

PeerDAS: шаг к многолетней цели Ethereum
Сооснователь Ethereum#ETH Виталик Бутерин отметил, что реализация PeerDAS является ключевым прорывом и фактическим приближением сети к концепции шардинга. По его словам, PeerDAS позволяет достигать консенсуса без необходимости передачи полного объёма данных узлам, что делает сеть более гибкой, быстрой и устойчивой к атакам 51%.
Бутерин подчеркнул, что реализация шардинга в рамках Fusaka пока неполная. Команде предстоит решить несколько технологических задач:

• создать полноценный механизм масштабирования для L1 при помощи ZK-EVM;

• устранить текущую форму централизации при формировании блоков;

• разделить единый пул транзакций на сегменты, чтобы равномерно распределять нагрузку по сети.
По оценке Бутерина, ближайшие два года будут посвящены тонкой настройке PeerDAS, расширению его возможностей и подготовке к дальнейшему увеличению лимита газа на L1.
Реакция рынка:#ETH показывает рост на фоне обновления
На фоне активации Fusaka цена #ETH выросла примерно на 3,6% за сутки и достигла уровня около 3200 долларов. Участники рынка позитивно восприняли обновление, отмечая его важность для долгосрочного развития экосистемы.
Некоторые аналитики сравнивают потенциал Fusaka с эффектом, который ранее произвёл хардфорк Pectra. Тогда курс ETH демонстрировал уверенное увеличение — более чем на 50% после активации обновления.
Трейдеры и инвесторы называют Fusaka «катализатором следующей фазы роста Ethereum». По их мнению, фундаментальные изменения ещё не полностью отражены в рыночной стоимости актива.

Следующий этап: подготовка к хардфорку Glamsterdam
После успешной активации Fusaka команда разработчиков сфокусируется на следующем обновлении — Glamsterdam, которое также входит в стадию The Surge. Основная цель — дальнейшее повышение пропускной способности сети, улучшение условий работы L2-решений и подготовка к финальной реализации шардинга.
Glamsterdam станет логическим продолжением Fusaka и ещё одним шагом на пути к созданию масштабируемой, доступной и экономичной инфраструктуры для миллионов пользователей и разработчиков.

Перспективы для экосистемы Ethereum
Fusaka открывает новые возможности для роста экосистемы #ETH Ethereum. Расширение лимита газа, улучшение механизмов обработки данных и развитие ZK-технологий создают основу для ускорения работы децентрализованных приложений, DeFi-платформ и инфраструктурных решений.
Интеграция PeerDAS и будущая реализация ZK-EVM могут значительно сократить стоимость транзакций и увеличить скорость обработки данных не только на уровне L2, но и в основной сети.

惊爆！Valour 上市数字资产 ETP，是数字资产狂欢序曲，还是风险陷阱前奏？

这次 Valour 在巴西 B3 交易所获批上市四只数字资产 ETP，对数字资产市场和巴西金融市场来说都是一件值得关注的事。

从数字资产市场角度看，这无疑是一个积极的信号。随着数字资产在全球的关注度不断提高，越来越多的传统金融机构开始涉足这一领域。此次在巴西重要交易所上市数字资产 ETP，说明数字资产的影响力正在进一步扩大，不再局限于小众的加密货币圈子，而是逐渐被主流金融市场所接纳。这对于提升数字资产的合法性和认可度有很大帮助，可能会吸引更多传统投资者进入数字资产市场，为市场带来更多的资金和活力。

对于巴西金融市场而言，这为当地投资者提供了新的投资选择。以前，巴西投资者想要投资数字资产可能面临诸多限制和不便，而现在通过在 B3 交易所上市的 ETP，他们可以像投资传统股票一样方便地参与数字资产投资。这不仅丰富了巴西金融市场的投资产品种类，也有助于提升巴西金融市场在国际上的竞争力。

不过，我们也不能忽视其中存在的风险。数字资产市场本身具有高度的波动性和不确定性，价格波动剧烈，投资者可能会面临较大的损失。而且，目前数字资产市场的监管还不够完善，存在一些潜在的风险和隐患。

总的来说，Valour 在巴西 B3 交易所上市数字资产 ETP 是数字资产市场发展的一个重要里程碑，但市场各方都需要在追求机遇的同时，警惕潜在的风险，共同推动数字资产市场的健康、稳定发展。

$ETH Price Action & The Fusaka Upgrade
Just checked the charts and Ethereum ($ETH) is currently trading at $3,185.01, showing a +3.65% move for the day!!!The market is certainly buzzing, and a huge part of the conversation is the recently activated Fusaka Upgrade...
✅What is the Fusaka Upgrade???
As you can see from the news banner on the chart, the Fusaka Upgrade highlights advancements in Sharding Technology. But what does that really mean for Ethereum???
⚡Massive Scalability Boost: Fusaka is a comprehensive network update that dramatically scales data availability, primarily to benefit Layer 2 (L2) rollups like Optimism and Arbitrum. It's built on innovative technologies like Peer Data Availability Sampling (PeerDAS), which is a form of sharding.
Cheaper Transactions: The upgrade increases the data capacity (blobs) available for L2s, which translates directly into significantly lower fees (expected to drop by 50-90%!) for users on these Layer 2 networks...
⚡Improved Efficiency: It strengthens the network's foundation by making it easier for a wider range of participants to run nodes, enhancing decentralization and reducing bandwidth requirements for validators. This is a crucial step toward achieving the long-term goal of Danksharding!!!
⚡The Role of Sharding Technology
Sharding is a technique borrowed from distributed databases and is key to improving blockchain scalability.
⚡The Problem: Without sharding, every single node on the network has to process every transaction. This limits speed and causes congestion (hello, high gas fees!).
⚡The Solution: Sharding divides the blockchain into smaller, manageable partitions called "shards." This spreads the workload, allowing transactions to be processed in parallel...
Fusaka's PeerDAS is a smart way to implement this for data availability, ensuring data is available without every node needing to download the entire dataset...

title: Покупки ефіру впали на 81% у листопаді: дані Bitwise сигналізують про кінець "трежери-буму"
subTitle:
Листопад 2025 року став холодним душем для ентузіастів Ethereum. За звітом Bitwise Asset Management, обсяг покупок ETH корпоративними скарбницями (DAT – digital asset treasuries) обвалився на 81%, скоротившись з піку в серпні на рівні 1,97 млн $ETH  до жалюгідних 370 тис. ETH. Це найнижчий показник за останні три місяці, що знаменує розпад стратегії, натхненної біткойн-скарбницями.
{future}(ETHUSDT)
Аналітики Bitwise, зокрема старший дослідник Макс Шеннон, порівнюють ситуацію з "альтсезоном" минулих циклів: початковий ейфорійний сплеск поступається місцем консолідації. "Той самий пул капіталу не може підтримувати попит на всі альтернативи", – зазначає Шеннон. Лідером ринку стає Bitmine (колишній MicroStrategy для ETH), який утримує 3,73 млн ETH – більше, ніж 68 конкурентів разом. Малі фірми стикаються з кризою: падіння mNAV (модифікованої чистої вартості активів) та слабке фінансування загрожують їхньому виживанню.

Хоча покупки DAT все ще перевищують місячну емісію ETH (близько 80 тис.), розрив звужується. Біткойн продовжує домінувати, а Ethereum ризикує стати "другим номером" у корпоративних портфелях. Bitwise радить інвесторам переглянути стратегії: фокус на лідерах, а не на хайпі.

Цей тренд підкреслює вразливість альткоїнів до циклічних зрушень. Чи чекає ETH відродження, чи подальше відставання?

title: Centralization vs. Decentralization—Why Security, Privacy, and Risk Management Decide the Winners
subTitle:
The Architectural Trade-Offs: Centralization vs. Decentralization in Digital Asset Trading—A Risk Assessment of Hybrid Exchange Models for Security, Liquidity, and User Privacy.

A lot of major exchanges have already experimented with decentralization. Some tried it multiple times, often releasing new models, then stepping back toward safer centralized structures. Not because decentralization failed, but because this entire shift requires several market cycles to solve UX, infrastructure, liquidity, and compliance challenges. You see it clearly in the RWA space: every cycle makes onboarding smoother, printing easier, and interoperability more seamless.
The same evolution is happening in DeFi. And right now, we’re in a cycle where serious CeFi–DeFi collaboration is finally taking shape. Platforms like Binance prove this with massive improvements to the Binance Wallet and new features like Binance Alpha that make buying and interacting with on-chain assets frictionless.
I’m a practical person, so I’ll say it directly: the future won’t be fully centralized or fully decentralized. Real adoption happens in the middle. Decentralization will dominate the infrastructure layer—execution, liquidity, settlement—while centralized platforms will support scaling, compliance, and easy onboarding. In a hybrid world, decentralization doesn’t lose; it becomes the backbone.
Are We “Indirectly” Working With Binance?
People sometimes assume we have an indirect partnership with Binance. The truth is: it’s complicated.
We work closely with the BNB Chain ecosystem—not directly with Binance corporate—because we’re building decentralized infrastructure alongside ecosystem partners who understand where the market is heading. If there’s one exchange we’d be most open to collaborating with, it’s definitely Binance. Their leadership recognizes how important decentralization is and why aligned projects matter.
We’ve also received valuable advice from Binance individuals over time. So can it be called an indirect connection? Depends how you define it. What’s certain is that anything is possible. One day the question might flip: not whether we’ll work with Binance, but whether Binance wants to work with us.
Why Security and Risk Management Are the Real Competitive Edge
Even the most aggressive trader—someone running complex strategies, high leverage, or tight execution timing—cares first about one thing: the safety of their funds.
Good traders have strong risk management. They want platforms that protect them not only from external threats like hacks, but also from internal risks: faulty market maker logic, poor liquidation engines, or misaligned incentives that create exploit surfaces.
We’ve built our name on that. The platform’s risk management systems have been tested in multiple scenarios, and we’ve consistently proven that we operate one of the most robust frameworks in the market. Only when users see that you can safeguard their funds do they start trusting you with their strategies, liquidity, and capital. Security always comes first—before growth, before brand, before anything.
After security comes capital efficiency. Traders care about execution costs: funding, fees, liquidity depth, slippage. A strategy that’s profitable on one venue might underperform elsewhere simply because of hidden costs. This is why we’ve focused heavily on making our platform one of the most efficient in the industry. When traders compare venues head-to-head, efficiency decides where they migrate.
Privacy: The Final Missing Layer
Let me turn the question around: would you show your bank balance live on a public stream? Of course not. And it’s the same in crypto.
Most traders don’t want the world to see their positions, sizes, or execution patterns. Yet transparency has been a double-edged sword in the decentralized space. A lot of competitors—even the ones I respect—haven’t fully solved this problem. You can copy-trade someone instantly just because everything is visible. That destroys alpha.
This is where privacy must evolve. You need privacy without compromising decentralization. Traders want confidentiality, but they don’t want to rely on centralized black boxes either. The next generation of decentralized venues must solve this natively.
Why Liquidity Follows Security
In the end, liquidity gathers where traders feel safest. That’s why the platforms that will dominate—whether centralized, decentralized, or hybrid—will be the ones that combine security, privacy, and capital efficiency into a single experience.

title: В среду Ethereum активировал обновление «Fusaka», это значительное изменение кода блокчейна в 2025 г
subTitle:
Обновление Fusaka стало логичным продолжением курса Ethereum на масштабирование без жёсткого увеличения требований к узлам. Это уже второй крупный хардфорк сети в 2025 году после весеннего обновления, и он официально активирован на основной сети в начале декабря.  Его задача — не «перепридумать» Ethereum, а подготовить базовый слой к жизни в мире, где львиная доля пользовательского трафика проходит через сети второго уровня. С технической точки зрения речь идёт о пересборке того, как база обрабатывает и хранит данные, чтобы L2 могли безопасно и дёшево масштабироваться поверх неё.
Ключевая идея Fusaka — сделать работу с данными для L2 более эффективной. В ядро протокола добавлен механизм выборочной проверки доступности данных (PeerDAS): валидаторы больше не обязаны проглатывать весь объём информации, а могут проверять лишь случайные части «блобов», сохраняя тот же уровень доверия.  Параллельно увеличиваются лимиты на данные и пропускная способность блоков, чтобы базовый слой физически успевал обслуживать растущий поток транзакций, приходящих из rollup-сетей. Для пользователя это выглядит просто: меньше перегрузок и более предсказуемые комиссии в периоды пиковых нагрузок.
Для разработчиков и операторов узлов Fusaka — это шаг в сторону «больше транзакций без безумных железных требований». Набор улучшений реализован через пакет EIP’ов, прошедших несколько тестнетов, что снижает риск неприятных сюрпризов на мейннете.  При этом архитектура построена так, чтобы не ломать совместимость с существующими контрактами и приложениями: для dApp’ов и кошельков всё продолжает работать как прежде, но под капотом сеть становится более гибкой к дальнейшему росту нагрузки.
Для рынка Fusaka — больше про фундамент, чем про мгновенную реакцию цены. В прошлых циклах крупные обновления уже становились катализаторами сильных движений по $ETH , но их истинный эффект раскрывался позже — через рост активности в экосистеме и перенос всё большего числа операций на L2.  Текущее обновление усиливает ту же линию: Ethereum всё меньше пытается «вместить весь мир в L1» и всё больше превращается в устойчивый расчётный слой для второго уровня. Для нас как участников это означает простую вещь: чем надёжнее и масштабируемее базовая инфраструктура, тем больше шансов, что следующий цикл роста в экосистеме будет опираться не на хайп, а на реально работающие технологии.

translatedData.title: On Wednesday, Ethereum activated the 'Fusaka' update, a significant change to the blockchain code in 2025.
translatedData.subTitle: The Fusaka update was a logical continuation of Ethereum's course towards scaling without a drastic increase in node requirements. This is the second major hard fork of the network in 2025 after the spring update, and it was officially activated on the mainnet in early December. Its goal is not to 'reinvent' Ethereum but to prepare the base layer for life in a world where the lion's share of user traffic passes through second-layer networks. From a technical standpoint, it involves reassembling how the database processes and stores data so that L2 can scale securely and cheaply on top of it.

After consecutive liquidations 8 times, I finally relied on a little-known strategy that no one wanted to learn, and within 20 days, I gained 1400%

Let me first state the conclusion:

Achieving a 1400% increase is not because I am capable, but because I finally "stopped making mistakes."

📌 This strategy may seem simple when I mention it

But simple things are rarely adhered to by anyone.

① I got rid of the "full position fantasy"

Previously, if I had 1000U, I would be eager to place an order for 1500U.

When the market fluctuated slightly, my emotions would explode.

Now I only do one thing:

For any position, the size does not exceed 10% of the total funds.

This one action has completely eliminated my liquidations.

② I started to only make "the most certain trade"

In the past, I could place over ten trades in a day,

Later, I began to limit my pace to:

Looking at the market only 2 times a day, only searching for 1 most stable position.

The result was quite surprising—

The fewer trades I made, the more I earned.

Because I no longer act impulsively to "prove I was right."

③ All stop losses and take profits are predetermined, without emotions

I write down all the trades before entering:

Loss of 3% must exit

+15% must take half

The remaining part only follows the trend, not emotions

Once trading becomes "execution of the plan,"

title: عملة إيثريوم ETH تتجاوز ٣٢٠٠ دولار مع استئناف "القروش الكبيرة" عملية التراكم
subTitle:
قفزة كبرى لعملة إيثريوم #ETH   بالتزامن مع تفعيل تحديث Fusaka الشبكي لتحسين قابلية التوسع
#ETH 
$ETH 
{future}(ETHUSDT)
كشف موقع U.Today أن سعر عملة إيثريوم ETH شهد ارتفاعا ملحوظا، متجاوزا مستوى ٣٢٠٠ دولار للمرة الأولى في الفترة الأخيرة وفقا لبيانات CoinGecko.

ويعزى هذا النمو إلى نشاط محافظ استثمارية مؤثرة تعرف بـ "القروش الكبيرة" أو "الحيتان الصغيرة"، والتي تمتلك ما بين ١٠٠٠ إلى ١٠٠٠٠ إيثريوم، وتشير بيانات شركة التحليلات Santiment إلى أن هذه المجموعة من المستثمرين قد استأنفت نشاط التراكم بثبات، مما أسهم في دفع حركة السعر للأعلى، ويعتبر نشاط هذه المحافظ "المؤشر الرئيسي" للأداء الإيجابي عملة إيثريوم ETH على مدار العام.

تحليل نشاط المحافظ الكبيرة والطلب الشبكي
وبحسب الموقع يكشف التحليل الدقيق أن فئة المحافظ التي تمتلك بين ١٠٠٠ و١٠٠٠٠ ETH كانت المحرك الخفي وراء الزخم الصعودي الأخير، ويظهر هذا النشاط ثقة متجددة من قبل مستثمري التجزئة الأثرياء والمؤسسات الصغيرة في المستقبل القريب للعملة.

بالإضافة إلى ذلك سجلت شبكة إيثريوم زيادة كبيرة في عدد المحافظ الجديدة، حيث تم إنشاء ١٩٠ ألف محفظة جديدة في يوم واحد، مما يعكس طلبا قويا وتبنيا متسارعا للشبكة، ويعد هذا المؤشر إيجابيا لاستمرار الزخم، حيث يقترن النمو في عدد المستخدمين الجدد مع تراكم من قبل حاملي الرصيد الكبير.

الخلفية التقنية لارتفاع عملة إيثريوم #ETH 
ووفقا للموقع تزامن ارتفاع السعر الأخير مع التنشيط الناجح لأحدث تحديث رئيسي لشبكة إيثريوم، والذي يحمل اسم Fusaka على الشبكة الرئيسية في ديسمبر.

ويجمع التحديث بين ترقيتين: "Fulu" لطبقة الإجماع و"Osaka" لطبقة التنفيذ، ويركز Fusaka بشكل أساسي على تحسين "توافر البيانات" لتقنيات التوسع من الطبقة الثانية (L2) مثل Arbitrum وOptimism وBase، بهدف زيادة سعة المعاملات مع الحفاظ على تكلفة وتوزيع تشغيل العقد، إن هذه التحسينات تفيد بشكل مباشر بيئة التطبيقات اللامركزية (dApps) والمستخدمين عبر جعل المعاملات على الشبكات الثانوية أرخص وأسرع.

النظرة المستقبلية لعملة إيثريوم $ETH 
وأكد الموقع أن تحديث Fusaka يعد ثاني ترقية كبرى لشبكة إيثريوم في عام ٢٠٢٥ بعد تحديث Pectra في مايو، مما يؤكد التزام المطورين بتطوير الشبكة بشكل مستمر، ومع استمرار "القروش الكبيرة" في تراكم الاحتياطيات، وازدياد عدد مستخدمي الشبكة، وتحسين الأداء الفني عبر التحديثات، تتكون بيئة داعمة لاستمرار الزخم الإيجابي.

ويعزز نجاح الترقية أيضا من قدرة عملة إيثريوم ETH التنافسية في سوق التطبيقات اللامركزية والتمويل اللامركزي (DeFi)، ومع هذه العوامل مجتمعة، يترقب السوق اختبار عملة إيثريوم ETH لمقاومات أعلى في الفترة المقبلة.

title: $3B in Ethereum Shorts at Risk if ETH Tops $3,500
subTitle:
Over $3 billion worth of Ethereum short positions are currently at high risk as ETH approaches the crucial $3,500 resistance area. A breakout above this zone could spark a powerful short squeeze.

Ethereum is hovering just below one of its most important resistance levels. If buyers manage to push ETH beyond $3,500, the entire crypto market could experience a significant shift in momentum. Right now, major exchanges collectively hold more than $3 billion in open short positions. Any strong breakout could trigger widespread liquidations.

Shorts are bearish trades that gain when the asset price drops. However, when the market moves upward instead, short sellers are forced to buy back ETH to prevent further loss — a process that fuels a short squeeze. This surge in buying activity often drives the price even higher, creating a chain reaction.

Why the $3,500 Level Matters

The $3,500 zone acts as both a psychological barrier and a major technical resistance. Over recent weeks, Ethereum has attempted to break above this level several times but sellers have consistently pushed it back down. A solid close above $3,500 would confirm strong bullish strength.

Market data shows that more than $3 billion in shorts could be liquidated if ETH surpasses this level. Such a move could lead to a sharp upward rally, similar to previous historic squeezes in the crypto market.

ALERT: If Ethereum rises above $3,500, over $3 billion in short positions may be wiped out. 

What Traders Should Expect

A breakout above $3,500 could trigger heavy losses for short sellers while rewarding long positions. Volatility is expected to increase, as liquidations often accelerate market movements to the upside.

For traders already holding ETH or looking to enter, the next few days may prove critical. A successful move above resistance could not only clear out shorts but also attract additional buyers, potentially driving ETH toward the $4,000 region.

title: 在币圈凭运气500块赚到1000万
subTitle:
2017年的时候有个小学同学，当时突然买了一台路虎，当时我还挺好奇，怎么突然就有钱了，然后他说你还记不记得我小的时候骗钱曾经被我爸妈一起打了一顿........
回到2010，那个是老博小学同学，他当时小的时候是被人骗了，然后当时是有一个什么活动就是你去参加那个活动我会给你发点卡。然后这个哥们就去了那个时候应该2011年当时反正上面那个人就感觉像是一个大忽悠，然后就在上面讲说什么，这个东西以后一定会很有发展前景怎么着怎么着，当时我记得很清楚，因为我们应该是刚过完年那会儿手里，应该有一些压岁钱，然后这哥们当时对那个大哥的话深信不疑，我记得当时他们买那个东西的时候，好像是给了一个密码本一样的东西，当时我没记错的话，好像大概是这样了。然后当时我没记错的话，好像是他买的价格应该是五块钱一个大饼，然后这个大哥当时有500块钱的压岁钱，他就把这些钱全部都买了这个.....后面的结果很直接就是他的父母，当时问他要压岁钱的时候他就说了这个情况。然后最后的结果就是免不了一顿毒打。
原因是因为当时大家都觉得他被骗了，因为我爸爸是做金融的，所以当时我还问他，他还跟我说你这个同学就被骗啦，那个时候100个大饼3美金，当时也就是差不多25块钱吧。后来我就把这个事情给他说了，然后这个同学当时也很无语，也很难过。不过当时我还挺开心的，因为我跟着他就听那个讲座给了我一张30qb点卡他也有一张我说我也不让你白花钱，我给你充个钻。
后面时间过得飞快到了2017年，我们都是在2017年高考的，结果这个时候我那个同学搬家了…….搬家的时候他找到密码本，不过我觉得这个世上最魔幻了你知道是什么，是那个密码本上，居然是有一个回收大饼的那种商人的联络方式。(其实我不知道这一点是真的还是假的，还是他骗我的)反正是当时他想起这个事情来了，然后他通过了一系列的渠道使用他的密钥结果发现他真的有100个大饼。结果那一天他一夜没睡着觉。
原因是因为他不知道这个事情该不该给他父母说，我记得差不多，应该是在十二月份的时候，我接到了他这个电话，因为我是我们这批同学里面惟一一个算是好一点学校的法学专业的。然后他主要是想咨询一下这个法律与风险这一块儿问题。然后最后他差不多在那个时候成交的价格，我印象非常深刻，应该是17689u一个。然后100个是好像是接近1,800,000u当时的时候折合人民币应该是1000多个这是我知道的其中一个暴富的。
最后这个事情他还是给他父母说了，听他跟我说，当时他父母准备把他那个本子撕了，这哥们当时，拼死保护保护下来的。最后好像是他父母人生中第一次向他诚挚的道歉。当然他现在手里的钱又不止1000多个了……有懂行的朋友知道为什么吗?所以说这是我认识的一个凭运气在这个领域暴富的。
还是那句话，牛市不知道怎么做，点开陈熙头像，关注，牛市现货策划，合约密码，无偿分享。#比特币 #eth

translatedData.title: Making 10 million from 500 in the crypto world by luck
translatedData.subTitle:
In 2017, there was an elementary school classmate who suddenly bought a Land Rover. I was quite curious about how suddenly he had money, and then he said, 'Do you remember when I was a kid, I was beaten up by my parents for scamming money...'
Back in 2010, that was an old elementary school classmate. When he was a kid, he was deceived, and there was some kind of event where if you participated, they would give you some cards. So this guy went, and it should have been in 2011. The person in charge felt like a big scammer, and they were saying things like this will definitely have great development prospects in the future. I remember it very clearly because we had just passed the New Year, and we should have had some lucky money. This guy believed the older guy's words unconditionally. I remember when they bought that thing, it seemed like they were given something like a password book. If I remember correctly, it was roughly like that. And if I remember correctly, the price he bought it for should have been five yuan for a big pancake. This older guy had 500 yuan of lucky money at the time, and he spent all of it to buy this... The outcome was straightforward; when his parents asked him for his lucky money, he explained the situation. In the end, he couldn't escape a beating.

Ethereum has just activated Fusaka, one of the most significant updates in its recent history and the most decisive technical step since Dencun 🚀. The change comes at a crucial moment: ETH is priced at $3,185 with a daily appreciation of 5.63%, a market capitalization of $384.42 billion, and a volume of $28.49 billion, according to verified data from CoinMarketCap 📊.

Fusaka is not a simple adjustment: it is a profound reconfiguration of the data flow from layer 2 blockchains to the main blockchain 🔄. It structurally alters how Ethereum scales 📈.

What is Fusaka and why is it so important? 🤔 Fusaka — a conceptual combination of Fulu and Osaka — consists of two simultaneous updates, one in the execution layer and another in the consensus layer 🔒. Together, they comprise 12 EIPs (Ethereum Improvement Proposals) designed to address Ethereum's current biggest challenge: the enormous volume of transactions originating from Layer 2 💸.

At the heart of Fusaka is PeerDAS, a new system that allows validators to verify only fragments of data instead of downloading the entire "blobs," as was done until now 🔍. This means less congestion, more capacity, and significantly lower layer 2 fees 💰.

The reaction and logic are clear: less congestion, lower costs for level 2, greater sustainability for validating large-scale transactions, and better experiences for users and developers 🚀.

Fusaka does not promise an immediate price increase, but it strengthens the long-term argument: Ethereum is building real capacity to absorb millions of daily transactions without compromising decentralization 🌐.

I used 26 days to roll 1900U into 38,000U, and I found that no one online talks about this method.

To be honest, when I first entered the market, I only had 1900U, and all I thought was: “If I can double it, I’ll be grateful.”

But what truly surprised me was not the profit,

but the moment on the 26th day when I saw my account balance——38,000U.

I was stunned for three minutes.

Did you think I relied on insider information? On tips? On gambling?

No, what I relied on was a method that even I considered "silly."

My true comeback was not because I made money quickly

but because:

I am more cautious than anyone else and steadier than anyone else.

While others are looking for coins that skyrocket and betting on big fluctuations,

I only do:

small, certain trades that allow me to sleep well.

While others go all in, I slowly roll with a small position.

While others panic and add to their positions, when I lose, I just admit my mistake and exit.

While others see the market with greedy eyes, I avoid it more the more intense it gets.

You see, this is what is called "a method that no one is willing to talk about":

It’s not a divine skill; it’s discipline, it’s restraint, it’s not being reckless.

What truly helped me turn around are 3 details (you can use them tomorrow)

I can guarantee you know all three points,

but you might not have executed them seriously even once.

① For each trade, I only aim to earn 8% to 12%, never chasing higher

I established this range after testing it for many days,

It allows me to have stable profits and very little drawdown.

Not being greedy is enough.

② Cut positions when winning, stop when losing, never "fight the market hard"

Most people lose due to emotions,

not because of their skills.

I actually reduce my position when I am continuously profitable, keeping calm.

When I continuously lose, I take a break, not testing my bottom line.

Stability comes from “rhythm,” not from a single breath.

③ Clearly defined stop-loss points, exit when it drops, never dragging

I stop-loss very quickly,

so much so that many friends say I’m like a robot.

But it’s these small losses

that keep me out of big pits.

When others are stunned by a big correction,

I am already waiting for the next opportunity.

#ETH #ZEC   BOB

我用 26 天，把 1900U 滚成 3.8 万U而且我发现，这方法全网没人讲。

说实话，我当初进场时只有 1900U，心里想的不过是：“能翻一倍就谢天谢地。”

但真正让我意外的不是盈利，

而是 第 26天看到账户余额的那一刻——3.8 万U。

整个人愣了三分钟。

你以为我靠内幕？靠消息？靠梭哈？

不，我靠的是一个连我自己都嫌“笨”的做法。

我真正的逆袭，不是因为赚得快

而是因为：

我比谁都怂，比谁都稳。

别人天天找暴涨币、赌大波动，

我偏偏只做：

小幅度、确定性、能睡得着的单。

别人全仓冲，我小仓慢滚。

别人亏急了补仓，我亏就直接认错退出。

别人看行情红眼，我看行情越激烈越躲。

你看，这就是所谓“没人愿意讲的方法”：

不是神技，是自律，是克制，是不作死。

 真正帮助我翻身的，是 3 个细节（你明天就能用）

我敢保证这三点你都知道，

但你可能一次都没认真执行过。

① 每单只想赚 8%～12%，从不追更高

这个范围我反复试了很多天才定下来，

它让我盈利稳定、回撤极小。

不贪，就够用。

② 连赢减仓，连亏停手，绝不“硬刚市场”

大部分人输在情绪，

不是输在技术。

我连续盈利反而减仓，保持冷静。

连续亏损就休息，不试探底线。

稳定来自“节奏”，不是一口气。

③ 明确止损点，跌到就走，从不拖

我止损非常快，

以至于很多朋友说我像机器人。

但正是这些小亏，

把我挡在大坑外。

当别人被大回调打懵时，

我已经在等下一个机会。

title: 如何滚仓，让自己暴富
subTitle:
如何滚仓：
滚仓的几点注意的地方：
1. 足够的耐心，滚仓的利润是巨大的，只要你能滚成功几次就可以至少赚上千万上 亿，所以你不能轻易的滚，要找确定性高的机会；
2. 确定性高的机会指的是暴跌后横盘震荡，然后向上突破，这时候走趋势的概率是很大的，找准趋势逆转的点，一开始就要上车。
3. 只滚多；
滚仓风险
如果你在比特币1W开仓，杠杆设置为10倍，使用逐仓模式，只开10%的仓位，就 是只开5K块钱作为保证金，其实这等于1倍杠杆，2个点止损，如果你止损了，只 亏2%,只亏2%啊？ 1000块。那些爆仓的人到底是怎么爆仓的？就算你爆仓了好 吧，不也就只亏5K？怎么能全亏完的。
假如你对了，比特币涨到了 1.1W,你继续开总资金的10%,同样设置亏2%止损， 如果止损了，你还赚8%,风险呢？不是说风险很大吗？ 以此类推。。。。
假如比特币涨到了 1.5W,你都加仓顺利，这波50%的行情，你应该可以赚到20W 左右，抓住两次这样的行情就是100W左右了。
根本不存在复利，100倍是靠2次10倍，3次5倍，4次3倍赚出来的，不是靠每天每 个月10% 20%复利起来的，那是扯淡。
滚仓这种理念本身并没有风险，不仅没有风险而且还是做期货最正确的思路之一， 有风险的是杠杆。10倍杠杆可以滚，1倍一样可以，而我一般用两三倍，抓住两次 不是一样几十倍收益？再不济你可以用0.几倍，这个跟滚仓有啥关系啊，这个明明 是你自己杠杆的选择问题，我可从来没有说过让你高杠杆去操作。
而且我一直强调，币圈只投自己五分之一的钱，同时只投现货十分之一的钱去玩期货，此时期货的资金只占你总资金的百分之2,同时期货只使用两三倍杠杆，而且 只玩比特币，可以说把风险降低到极低了。100W没了2W你会心疼吗？
小资金如何做大
很多人对交易都有很多误区，比如说，小资金应该做短线才能把资金滚大，这就是完完全全的误区，这种思维完全就是想用时间换空间，企图一夜暴富，小资金更应 该做中长线才能做大。

Many friends ask me: "Teacher, I only have 100 as starting capital, can I earn more?" The answer is yes, but the premise is to avoid the pitfall of going all in. The market does not only recognize "more money"; I started with 200 in principal, not relying on luck to make big money, but on a simple set of rolling warehouse principles.

1. Break down the goal, don't be greedy.

First, set a smaller goal, turning 100 into 300, divided into 3 rounds of small battles, earning 30-50 each round will do, less pressure means more stable operations. Earning 40 at a time is much easier than earning 900 at once!

2. Lock in profits.

After completing each round of goals, transfer half of the profits to a safe account and continue operating with the rest. One of my fans did this, and after three months, their profits doubled, and they also earned back their tuition.

3. Allocate positions by importance, with risk management.

70% of the position in stable varieties, 20% in rolling warehouse, and 10% left empty as backup. Even if the judgment is wrong, the losses are limited, avoiding major losses.

Many people say the "fast lane" is more exciting, but did you know? Nine out of ten fast cars head to the rooftop. The essence of rolling warehouse is to cultivate the ability to interact with the market, knowing when to act and when to hold back. This is a skill that can last a lifetime.

Small capital does not mean a disadvantage; rather, it is a good opportunity for you to test and refine your trading system. Once you can steadily use 100 to profit, the same approach applies to 1000 or 10000.💡

100变1000？别拿“钱少”当借口，看看我的滚仓秘籍！

有不少朋友问我：“老师，我只有100个启动资金，能不能赚到更多？” 答案是肯定的，但前提是得避开全仓梭哈的坑。市场从不只认“钱多”，我从200个本金起步，没靠运气赚大钱，而是靠了一套简单的滚仓心法。

1. 拆分目标，别贪心。

先把目标定小一点，从100变成300，分成3轮小战役，每轮赚30-50个就行，压力小操作稳。一次赚40个比一次赚900个容易多了！

2. 盈利必锁仓。

每完成一轮目标，把一半盈利转到安全账户，剩下的继续操作。我的一个粉丝就这样，三个月后盈利翻倍，学费也赚了。

3. 仓位分主次，风险兜底。

7成仓位做稳健品种，2成仓位滚仓，1成仓位空着备用。即便判断错了，损失也有限，避免大亏。

很多人说“快车道”更刺激，但你知道吗？十辆快车九辆开往天台。滚仓的精髓是培养与市场相处的能力，知道什么时候该出手，什么时候该收手。这才是能吃一辈子的本事。

title: Биткоин против золота:Чанпен Чжао и Питер Шифф провели открытую дискуссию о природе ценности активов
subTitle:
Основатель Binance Чанпен Чжао (CZ) и известный экономист Питер Шифф обсудили роль биткоина#BTC  и золота в современной финансовой системе. Диалог затронул фундаментальные вопросы стоимости активов, технологических преимуществ блокчейна и динамики инвестиционного рынка.

Шифф: золото остаётся материальным активом с прикладной ценностью
Питер Шифф подчеркнул, что золото на протяжении десятилетий сохраняет статус защитного инструмента и используется не только как инвестиционный актив, но и в промышленности. Он отметил, что токенизированные версии золота могут служить подтверждением владения физическим металлом, что усиливает доверие к подобным решениям.
По мнению экономиста, стоимость#BTC биткоина формируется преимущественно за счёт рыночного спроса и не опирается на материальную базу. Шифф заявил, что отсутствие физического обеспечения делает волатильность криптовалюты значительной, а её фундаментальная ценность, по его оценке, «неочевидна».

Чжао: биткоин предлагает прозрачность, ограниченную эмиссию и технологическую эффективность
В ответ Чанпен Чжао отметил, что биткоин#BTC нельзя оценивать по тем же критериям, что и традиционные товары. Он подчеркнул, что технология блокчейн обеспечивает полную прозрачность поставки и движения цифровых активов, тогда как точный объём мировых запасов золота оценить невозможно.
По его словам, биткоин обладает рядом преимуществ, которые делают его удобным для глобальных расчётов:

• транзакции занимают минуты вместо дней;

• сеть функционирует без территориальных и банковских ограничений;

• эмиссия BTC математически ограничена, что снижает инфляционные риски.
Чжао отметил, что цифровые активы постепенно становятся полноценным инструментом для трансграничных платежей и финансовых операций.

Доходность: разные результаты на разных временных горизонтах
Спор коснулся и инвестиционной динамики активов. Питер Шифф заявил, что за последние четыре года золото демонстрировало более стабильный рост по сравнению с биткоином.
Чанпен Чжао предложил рассматривать более длительную временную шкалу. Он отметил, что за восемь лет биткоин #BTC значительно опережает золото по уровню доходности, отражая долгосрочный интерес инвесторов и растущую роль криптовалют на мировом рынке.
Платежи: криптовалюты ускоряют расчёты
CZ обратил внимание на удобство использования криптовалюты для оплаты услуг и товаров. Он напомнил, что блокчейн-транзакции происходят быстрее традиционных банковских переводов.
Питер Шифф возразил, что большинство криптокарт используют конвертацию в фиатные валюты, однако Чжао отметил, что конечный пользователь ориентируется на скорость и удобство платежа, а не на внутренние процессы обработки транзакций.
Итоги обсуждения
Несмотря на различия в позициях, дискуссия прошла в конструктивном формате. Участники обменялись аргументами и отметили растущее влияние цифровых активов на мировую экономику.
Питер Шифф в ходе разговора предложил рассмотреть возможность создания специальной карты для его бизнеса, однако участники остались при своих взглядах на роль золота и криптовалют#ETH в инвестиционных стратегиях.
Ранее Чанпен Чжао критиковал новый RWA-продукт, представленный компанией Schiff Gold, что стало одним из поводов для нынешнего обсуждения.

title: BitMine adds one hundred fifty million dollars in ETH as buying slows in the wider market
subTitle:
BitMine has once again added a large amount of Ethereum to its treasury. The company bought ETH worth one hundred fifty million dollars on Wednesday. This move came at a time when most digital asset treasuries are slowing down their ETH purchases. BitMine keeps growing its share while others step back.Onchain data from Arkham shows that BitMine added more than forty eight thousand ETH through two known service partners. The company has not confirmed the details but the activity fits the pattern that BitMine has been showing all year. BitMine has been buying ETH again and again even during weak market days. This new purchase continues that trend as the firm tries to reach its long term goal.BitMine wants to hold five percent of the total ETH supply. Right now the firm holds more than three percent. The company has been open about its plan to support Ethereum as it becomes a bigger part of financial market services. BitMine sees a strong future for ETH and is building a position that can shape the market in the long run.The rest of the digital asset treasury sector is doing the opposite. Data from Bitwise shows that these treasuries bought much less ETH in November. The total buying in November was around three hundred seventy thousand ETH which is far lower than the one point nine seven million ETH seen in August. That is a sharp drop and shows a clear shift in the wider market. Many firms are slowing down or holding back from making new large buys.BitMine is not following that trend. It has kept buying ETH even during November when the market was under pressure. In the last week of the month alone BitMine bought close to one hundred thousand ETH. This steady buying shows strong belief in Ethereum even when others are cautious.Tom Lee who leads BitMine remains positive about the near future of Ethereum. He said that several things are pushing ETH forward. One is the new Fusaka upgrade which went live earlier today. The upgrade is seen as a support for growth in the wider Ethereum system. Lee also pointed to the expected end of the Federal Reserves tightening cycle. He believes that less pressure from the central bank will help digital assets and give more strength to ETH.Lee said earlier this month that he sees ETH moving toward seven thousand to nine thousand dollars before the end of January twenty twenty six. Right now ETH trades at about three thousand two hundred fifteen which is higher than the day before. The price move adds confidence for those who see Ethereum rising further.BitMine stock also moved higher on Wednesday. It closed at thirty three point sixty six which was a gain for the day. The stock is still lower across the month but the recent rise shows that investors are watching the firms steady ETH plan.BitMine is choosing a clear path. It is buying and holding ETH while others slow down. This sets BitMine apart in a cooling market and keeps it in the center of the long term Ethereum story.

The momentum from this update is now showing clearly on shorter time frames.
The four hour chart is still rising with clean continuation. Each pullback has been shallow so far which shows buyers are active at every dip. As long as support stays healthy around the lower zone the uptrend keeps building. This range is becoming the key focus because ETH usually needs firm support before attempting big targets again. The current reaction shows the market still trusts the trend.
Some traders are already watching levels near three thousand two hundred and above. They believe the structure stays positive as long as dips remain controlled and funding stays balanced. Others think the move could take more time because Bitcoin dominance has been shifting. But even with different opinions the mood around ETH is more positive than last week. The market seems to agree that the upgrade and the technical setup are giving bulls the upper hand for now.
Today’s move has pushed ETH back into conversation across Binance Square. Many traders are asking if the trend can extend toward higher targets or if a deeper pullback will appear first. translatedData.subTitle:
Ethereum founder Vitalik Buterin has proposed three important structural updates to strengthen the network:
1. Limit the number of contract code bytes that can be accessed for each transaction.
2. Implement limits on the ZK-EVM proof cycle.
3. Restructure the EVM memory cost structure.
These changes focus on minimizing attack vectors and creating a safer and more predictable Ethereum ecosystem. Buterin emphasized that these updates will eliminate DoS risks, simplify client code, and enhance efficiency.

As the cryptocurrency market continues to evolve, one question dominates the minds of investors: What’s next for Binance Coin? The native token of the world’s largest cryptocurrency exchange has shown remarkable resilience and growth since its inception. This comprehensive analysis explores the Binance Coin price prediction for 2025 through 2030, examining whether the $1000 milestone is within reach.
Understanding Binance Coin’s Current Position
Binance Coin serves as the backbone of the Binance ecosystem, offering utility across trading fee discounts, token sales, payment processing, and decentralized applications. The token has evolved from a simple exchange utility token to a multifaceted asset powering one of the most comprehensive blockchain ecosystems. Recent developments including the expansion of the Binance Smart Chain (now BNB Chain) and increased adoption in decentralized finance have significantly enhanced BNB’s value proposition. The token’s performance has consistently outpaced many competitors, demonstrating strong fundamentals that support optimistic price predictions.
Key Factors Influencing BNB Price Forecast
Several critical elements will determine whether Binance Coin reaches $1000. Market adoption remains the primary driver, with BNB’s utility expanding beyond the Binance exchange into broader blockchain applications. Regulatory developments present both challenges and opportunities, as clearer frameworks could accelerate institutional adoption. Technological advancements on the BNB Chain, including scalability improvements and ecosystem growth, directly impact token demand. Additionally, broader cryptocurrency market trends and Bitcoin’s performance significantly influence BNB’s price movements, creating interconnected market dynamics that must be considered in any comprehensive BNB price forecast.
Technical Analysis for BNB Price Prediction
Examining historical patterns provides valuable insights for future projections. BNB has demonstrated strong support levels during market corrections while showing aggressive growth during bull cycles. Key technical indicators suggest:
Consistent upward trendlines since 2020
Strong volume support at major price levels
Resilience during market downturns compared to similar assets
Consolidation patterns that typically precede significant moves
These technical foundations support optimistic scenarios in most BNB price prediction models, particularly when combined with fundamental strengths.
Binance Coin Price Prediction 2025
Looking toward 2025, analysts present varied but generally positive outlooks for BNB. Conservative estimates suggest a range between $800-$900, assuming steady ecosystem growth and moderate market conditions. More optimistic projections reach $950-$1100, factoring in accelerated adoption of BNB Chain applications and potential market expansion. The $1000 target appears achievable if several conditions align: continued expansion of the Binance ecosystem, successful implementation of planned technological upgrades, and favorable regulatory developments. The Ultimate Target: BNB 2030 Projections
Looking toward the end of the decade, Binance Coin price prediction models become more speculative but remain grounded in observable trends. By 2030, BNB could reach between $2000-$2500 in optimistic scenarios, representing substantial growth from current levels. This projection assumes:
Mass adoption of blockchain technology

Favorable global regulatory environment
More conservative estimates place BNB between $1500-$1800 by 2030, still representing significant appreciation. The Binance Coin future appears bright, with the token positioned to benefit from multiple growth vectors within the cryptocurrency space.
Challenges That Could Impact BNB’s Growth
While the Binance Coin price prediction outlook appears positive, several challenges could affect progress toward $1000. Regulatory uncertainty remains a significant concern, with potential restrictions on cryptocurrency exchanges and tokens. Competition from other blockchain platforms continues to intensify, potentially dividing market share and developer attention. Technical challenges related to scalability and security must be continuously addressed to maintain BNB Chain’s competitive position. Additionally, market volatility inherent to cryptocurrency assets could create temporary setbacks even within a long-term growth trajectory. These factors must be considered alongside optimistic BNB price forecast models.
Actionable Insights for Investors
Based on current Binance Coin price prediction analysis, several strategies emerge for interested participants. Dollar-cost averaging reduces timing risk in volatile markets. title: 比特币突破94,000美元，以太坊独涨7%！12月牛市终于来了？
subTitle:
“这次不一样？”我盯着屏幕上的K线图，不禁自问。就在一周前，市场还弥漫着恐慌气息，比特币一度下探84,000美元。而如今，一切都变了——美联储降息预期高涨、机构资金通过ETF疯狂涌入、以太坊完成Fusaka升级，三股力量共同点燃了这场寒冬里的烈火
。

01 市场强势回归，龙头币种引领风骚
今天一早醒来，加密市场已经炸开了锅。比特币突破94,000美元，以太坊站稳3,200美元上方，两大龙头币种的强势表现，带动了整个市场的回暖
。

我仔细查看了数据，发现了一个有趣的现象：资金流向呈现“聪明钱”特征。那些有实际技术和生态支撑的主流价值币跟涨明显，而缺乏基本面支撑的山寨币、空气币则表现平平
。

这告诉我，市场正在走向成熟，资金不再盲目追逐概念，而是向优质项目集中。
以太坊本轮表现远超比特币，涨幅达到7.22%，远高于比特币的2.4%
。 其背后的独特点火器正是——以太坊Fusaka升级成功激活。

这次升级于12月4日执行，提升了网络数据容量和效率，并为Layer 2带来更低的交易费用
。

02 三重利好共振，打造牛市坚实基础
本次反弹并非偶然，而是三重利好因素集中兑现的结果，它们如同三根支柱，共同支撑起这轮上涨。
首先，宏观层面迎来了关键转折。市场对美联储12月降息25个基点的预期概率已升至86%-89%
。同时，美国“小非农”数据疲软，就业市场加速恶化，这反而进一步推动了降息预期升温。

其次，机构资金大幅回流。上周全球加密货币基金录得11亿美元净流入，创7周新高，逆转了此前连续4周流出的趋势
。

其中，比特币和以太坊ETF分别净流入4.61亿和3.08亿美元
。巨额资金流入是市场信心恢复最直接的信号。

最后，技术升级提供独立利好。以太坊Fusaka升级不仅是技术事件，更是心理催化剂。它向市场证明了以太坊网络的持续进化能力，为未来的通缩机制和性能提升奠定了基础
。

03 技术面揭示短期走势关键点位
从技术面看，比特币短期均线组开始呈现向上发散态势，意味着短期做多力量正在聚集
。不过，目前比特币仍受200日均线压制，尚未完全确立上涨态势。

我的观点是，比特币关键阻力区在94,500-95,000美元，突破后有望挑战96,000美元甚至更高。下方支撑则关注92,000-91,500美元区域，若跌破可能测试91,000美元
。

以太坊走势更为强劲，4小时级别形成“主升浪上涨形态”，甚至可以理解为W底
。其突破力度令人印象深刻，下一关键阻力在3,250-3,300美元区间。

需要注意的是，小时图RSI已接近74的超买区域，短期需警惕3,250-3,300区域获利回吐压力
。

一位资深交易员也提示，“ETH在四小时图上出现‘14连涨’的强劲走势，这增加了在关键阻力位回调的风险。”

04 实战策略：如何把握机会与控制风险
面对当前市场，我制定了以下策略，供大家参考：
对于比特币，我建议采取回调做多策略。理想的多单入场区间在92,000-92,500美元，止损设在91,500美元下方，目标位看向94,500-95,000美元
。

若价格直接反弹至94,500-95,000美元区域遇阻，可轻仓试空，止损设在95,500美元，目标回看93,000美元附近
。

对于以太坊，强势突破后，建议回踩做多为主。理想多单入场区间在3,120-3,150美元，止损设在3,030美元下方，目标看向3,250-3,300美元
。

若价格直接冲击3,250-3,300美元阻力区，可考虑轻仓试空，止损设在3,350美元，目标回看3,150-3,100美元
。

仓位管理是重中之重。我建议单次交易仓位不超过总资金的15%，总仓位控制在50-60%，预留足够现金应对可能出现的回调
。

05 风险提示：狂欢中保持清醒头脑
虽然市场一片欢腾，但我们必须看到潜在的风险。
宏观层面存在变数。美联储12月议息会议尚未最终落地，任何预期变化都可能引发市场剧烈波动
。我们就像在沙滩上建城堡，潮水方向改变可能瞬间冲垮一切。

技术面显示市场深度不足。当前反弹成交量并未完全恢复，市场流动性相对薄弱，容易因大额卖单或负面消息出现剧烈波动
。

杠杆风险尤为突出。市场杠杆率仍较高，若出现极端行情，可能引发连锁爆仓
。近期24小时内就有超10.6万人爆仓，总金额3.6亿美元——这些都是血淋淋的教训。

一位分析师也提示了技术风险：“部分技术指标已显示出上涨动能减弱或潜在反转的早期信号，增加了回调的可能性。”

未来几天，市场将重点关注美联储12月议息会议的最终决定
。同时，以太坊升级后网络数据的实际表现也将是判断反弹能否延续的关键。

窗外，加密市场的狂欢仍在继续。看着比特币在94,000美元附近徘徊，我微微一笑——也许这就是市场的魅力所在，永远充满了不确定性与可能性。
无论你是多头还是空头，请记住：活下去才是最重要的。​ 牛市不是靠一两次豪赌赚来的，而是在一次次波动中活下来的奖赏。#BTC #ETH

title: Ethereum встановлює новий рекорд: понад 3,5 млн TPS у день.
subTitle:
Ethereum знову демонструє свою міць: 3 грудня 2025 року мережа досягла історичного максимуму – 3,579 транзакцій за секунду (TPS) у піковий день. За даними BlockNuggets, це перевершує попередні рекорди, зумовлені стрімким зростанням $ETH  до $3,000+ та масовим адопшеном Layer-2 рішень. Загальна добова активність сягнула 2,1 млн транзакцій, з TVL у L2-екосистемах на рівні $45 млрд.

Цей сплеск пояснюється апгрейдами Dencun (березень 2025) та Osaka (листопад), які знизили gas fees до $0,50–$1 за транзакцію. Rollups як Optimism та Arbitrum обробляють 90% трафіку, роблячи Ethereum масштабованим для DeFi, NFT та ігор. 🚨Vitalik Buterin, co-founder of Ethereum, celebrated the activation of PeerDAS in the Fusaka update, describing it as the "true sharding" that the network has aimed for since 2015 🚀. 

PeerDAS allows Ethereum to reach consensus on valid blocks without any node needing to view all the complete data of each block 🔒.

This makes the network faster, cheaper, and more decentralized 💸. The system does not rely on the majority of validators "voting correctly", but rather on each user’s ability to independently and probabilistically verify if the data is available 📊.

PeerDAS addresses a critical data availability issue, making it harder to convert a 51% attack into a successful attack against data availability 🔐. Buterin highlights that Ethereum is reaching consensus on blocks without requiring any individual node to see more than a small fraction of the data 📈.

With Fusaka and PeerDAS, Ethereum can scale more effectively through Layer 2 (L2) technologies, such as rollups 🚀. However, Buterin acknowledges that there are still points to improve, such as scalability at Layer 1 and distributed block construction 📝.

AI Summary
Bitcoin weakened in early Asia trading on Monday, sliding under $87,500 as Japanese bond yields spiked to levels not seen since 2008. The move strengthened the yen, accelerated carry-trade unwinds, and triggered a wave of crypto liquidations during thin liquidity hours.
The pressure followed a sharp rise in Japan’s short-term government bond yields — a shift that traders increasingly interpret as a sign the Bank of Japan (BOJ) may be preparing its first rate hike in more than a decade.
Japan Yields Surge, Sending Shockwaves Through Crypto Markets
Japan’s 2-year bond yield briefly reached 1.01%, the highest in 17 years, after BOJ Governor Kazuo Ueda said policymakers would assess whether a rate hike is appropriate at this month’s meeting.
The comments accelerated yen buying and caused leveraged traders to unwind risk positions funded through yen carry trades — a dynamic that has supported global risk assets throughout 2025.
Crypto, which is extremely sensitive to overnight liquidity moves in Asia, was hit immediately:
Bitcoin dropped below $87,500, triggering forced liquidations
Ether slid toward $2,850
Both BTC and ETH long positions saw more than $290 million combined in liquidations
Liquidity remained thin across perpetual futures markets, magnifying the downside move
Prediction markets reacted quickly. On Polymarket, the probability of a December BOJ rate hike rose to roughly 50%, up seven percentage points on the day.
Why Japan Matters: Yen Strength and Carry Trades Put Pressure on Crypto
The yen’s rapid strengthening is central to the market volatility. For much of the year, traders have borrowed cheaply in yen to buy higher-yielding assets — including equities and crypto.
A sudden shift toward BOJ tightening leads to:
A stronger yen
Forced deleveraging of carry trades
Lower liquidity for risk assets
Accelerated crypto sell-offs during Asia hours

⚙️ ETH “Fusaka”: The Upgrade Aiming to Make Ethereum Faster & Cheaper 💡

Ethereum keeps evolving, and the upcoming “Fusaka” upgrade is designed to improve speed, scalability, and transaction costs.
Here’s a simple breakdown for beginners.

🔹 What is Fusaka?
Think of it as a system upgrade that improves how Ethereum processes activity. Fusaka focuses on:

Lower gas fees (especially on Layer 2s)

Higher network capacity

More efficient smart contract execution

Better stability for DeFi, NFTs and daily users

You won’t “see” the upgrade directly, but you’ll feel the benefits through smoother and cheaper transactions.

🔹 Why does it matter?
Ethereum is heavily used by DeFi apps, NFT platforms and Layer 2 networks. When usage spikes, costs rise. Fusaka helps the network handle more activity without slowing down.

🔹 A simple before/after snapshot 📊

Before Fusaka:
• Higher fees during peak hours
• Occasional congestion

After Fusaka:
• Cheaper, more predictable gas costs
• Higher transaction throughput

🔹 Do users need to do anything?
No. Holders, stakers and dApp users don’t need to take action. Validators and developers manage the upgrade in the background.

🎯 Takeaway
Fusaka is another step toward a more scalable, user-friendly Ethereum — especially for newcomers exploring DeFi or Layer 2 networks.

title: 🔥 Ethereum: головний двигун Web3, який може задати темп у 2026 році
subTitle:
Світ блокчейну змінюється швидше, ніж будь-коли, і кожен новий цикл формує своїх лідерів. Але серед усіх проєктів є ті, що не просто виживають — вони створюють правила гри. Один із таких — Ethereum, головна платформа для смарт-контрактів, DeFi, NFT та Web3. І саме він може стати ключовим активом крипторинку у 2026 році.

Чому? Тому що Ethereum — це не просто монета. Це ціла фінансова та технологічна інфраструктура, на якій працюють тисячі протоколів: DeFi-платформи, децентралізовані біржі, DAO, геймінг, RWA (токенізація реальних активів), L2-рішення та неймовірна кількість dApps. Зміцнення екосистеми — це прямий драйвер попиту на ETH.

У 2026 році індустрія рухатиметься в напрямку масової токенізації активів, масштабованості, приватності та інтеграції ШІ у децентралізовані фінанси. Ethereum вже знаходиться в самому центрі цього процесу. Завдяки розвитку Layer 2 (Arbitrum, Optimism, Base, zkSync) мережа стає швидшою та дешевшою, знімаючи навантаження з основної мережі та залучаючи нові проєкти.

Не менш важливо — модель “Ultra Sound Money”, яка робить ETH дефляційним активом у довгостроковій перспективі. Менше емісії + спалювання комісій = обмежена пропозиція. Це те, що може зробити Ethereum сильним інструментом зростання під час наступного ринку.

ETH — це не хайпова монета й не тренд дня. Це паливо для смарт-контрактів, основа роботи більшості Web3-протоколів, інструмент стейкінгу, ключ до RWA, rollup-економіки та майбутніх інтеграцій ШІ у фінанси. Поки екосистема розширюється — попит на ETH тільки зростатиме.

Так, ринок непередбачуваний. Але активи з реальним застосуванням і величезним ком’юніті завжди мають більше шансів пройти через цикли та вийти на нові вершини. Якщо розширення Web3, розвиток L2 і масова токенізація активів продовжаться — Ethereum стане одним із головних бенефіціарів.

2026 рік може стати моментом прориву для Ethereum. І якщо ти шукаєш актив із масштабом, фундаментом і глобальною місією — ETH точно має бути в списку монет, за якими варто стежити.

title: Курс Ethereum отреагировал ростом на активацию обновления Fusaka
subTitle:
Цена Ethereum ($ETH ) показала рост после активации в блокчейне обновления Fusaka. Ведущий альткоин 4 декабря достиг отметки $3238, обновив максимум за две с половиной недели.
За сутки ETH подорожал на 4%, тогда как биткоин ($BTC ) потерял 0,2%, а общая капитализация крипторынка за то же время выросла на 1%. На 15:45 мск Ethereum торгуется около $3,18 тыс.
Обновление Fusaka было запущено в основной сети Ethereum в ночь на 4 декабря. По словам разработчиков, это обновление должно открыть «новый этап масштабирования и путь к параллельному выполнению задач», что означает повышение скорости обработки транзакций и снижение их стоимости.
Рост Ethereum выше $3,2 тыс. произошел благодаря значительным покупкам «акул» рынка, хранящих на своих криптокошельках от 1 тыс. до 10 тыс. ETH, считают в Santiment. Аналитики пояснили, что эти кошельки были ключевыми для определения цены альткоина на протяжении всего 2025 года. Кроме того, число новых адресов в сети Ethereum только за один день достигло 190 тыс.
Fusaka вносит изменения, которые делают транзакции более безопасными и простыми в проведении. Эксперты, опрошенные Decrypt, считают, что это расширит базу валидаторов и снизит риск централизации.
Другое мнение высказал бывший ведущий разработчик крупного ПО для Ethereum Петер Силадьи, заявляя, что новое обновление угрожает децентрализации сети. Оно увеличит нагрузку на ноды, требуя скорости интернета до 2,5 Гб/с для передачи данных. Это сделает невозможным работу домашних валидаторов и приведет к централизации. В результате проверка сети останется децентрализованной, но контроль над ней окажется в руках крупных игроков.
